**Claude review** of the whole pull request, at `9333491`: all 4 files reviewed.

0 finding(s), 0 to fix; 0 on their lines. Reply in a comment's thread to answer it.

### Summary

I found no issues in this PR. The cache key uses `sameScene`, which compares the inner `beautify`, `annotations` and `crop` references, so a rebuilt scene wrapper still hits the cache. Any edit produces new inner references and misses it. A failed composite clears its own entry. The editor clears the cache on unmount. The one caller of `exportScene` hands the buffer straight to `copyImageToClipboard`, which goes over IPC. IPC clones the buffer, so the shared result is not transferred or mutated. The diff stays inside the renderer and doesn't touch the Electron boundary or `shared/**`. The tests cover the cache hit, each invalidation, format separation, failure and concurrent calls.
